memory_and_restart_policy: Unchanged pinned Compose, including checkout's 20 MiB memory ceiling, GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB and restart=unless-stopped. Events and segmented memory counters diagnose failures; this follow-up does not isolate memory from CPU as a separate intervention.

workload.capacity_basis: Maximum rate times two HTTP timeouts: max(32*20,40*10)=640 occupied VUs; 800 adds 25% overhead allowance. Capacity and generator CPU are verified, not assumed, during every point.

observation.restart_rule: Post-intervention restart/OOM is diagnostic only; never changes the SLO label or triggers a replacement.
observation.counter_rule: No counter delta is computed across a changed cgroup inode, a changed PID, or a counter reset.
observation.generator_headroom_rule: Record host CPU and generator cgroup CPU; report maximum and mean without a fitted cutoff. The primary generator-validity gate is at least 99% started in baseline and test.
